newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1996 trade deficit seen at $19 bln.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1996 trade deficit seen at $19 bln.

text.p: South Korea's trade ministry expects the country's customs-cleared trade deficit to reach about $19 billion in 1996, up from $10.1 billion last year, a senior ministry official said on Monday.
"The shortfall will be much larger than earlier expected because of a slump in semiconductor exports," said Lee Jae-kil, director-general of the ministry's trade division.
At the beginnig of this year, the ministry projected the deficit would fall to about $7.0 billion.
Semiconductor shipments for this year were now estimated at $18 billion, down sharply from the ministry's January projection of $30.7 billion, Lee said.
Trade deficit in the first 11 months of this year was $18.64 billion, up from $10.01 billion in the same 1995 period, the ministry said.
